# CiteReady Pro & CLI — Complete AI Search (GEO), llms.txt & Schema.org Technical SEO Reference

> Official full-context LLM reference for CiteReady by OmniForge Studio.

## Product Overview

CiteReady helps SaaS founders, documentation engineers, and technical SEO agencies verify and fix how AI answer engines — including ChatGPT Search (`OAI-SearchBot`), Perplexity (`PerplexityBot`), Anthropic Claude (`ClaudeBot`), Google AI Overviews (`Google-Extended`), and Apple Intelligence (`Applebot-Extended`) — crawl, parse, and cite websites.

- **Homepage & Live Browser Scanner:** https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/
- **Full Cloud GEO Diagnostic:** https://citeready-checker.appwrite.network
- **2026 GEO Tool Comparison ($19 One-Time vs. $99–$499/mo Trackers):** https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/compare.html
- **GitHub Action CI/CD Guide:** https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/llms-txt-github-action-guide.html
- **Open-Source Repository (MIT):** https://github.com/zColdWater/citeready-cli

## Open-Source CLI & GitHub Action (`v1.1.0`)

Run a zero-install single-URL audit from any terminal (Node.js 18+):

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/citeready-cli check https://yoursite.com
npx github:zColdWater/citeready-cli check https://yoursite.com --min-score 80 --require-llms-txt --require-jsonld
```

Or enforce AI Search & Schema.org readiness in GitHub Actions (`uses: zColdWater/citeready-cli@v1`):

```yaml
- name: Audit AI Search & Schema.org Readiness
  uses: zColdWater/citeready-cli@v1
  with:
    url: https://yoursite.com
    min-score: "80"
    require-llms-txt: "true"
    require-jsonld: "true"
```

Unlike $99–$499/month synthetic prompt trackers (such as Profound, Otterly.AI, or Peec AI) that only monitor mentions passively, CiteReady Pro runs 100% locally on Node.js 20+ to generate and enforce the technical assets answer engines crawl:

1. **CiteReady Pro — Solo Edition ($19 One-Time)**

   - Automatic `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` Markdown compiler with boilerplate stripping and token estimation
   - Validated Schema.org JSON-LD generator (`SoftwareApplication`, `Product`, `Organization`, `FAQPage`, `HowTo`)
   - Custom `robots.txt` policy builder (allow citation bots while optionally restricting training scrapers)
   - Local interactive GEO workbench (`citeready serve`) + multi-URL CI gate
